textRuns.value: Insight 1: Late delivery is strongly associated with bad reviews - late orders average 2.27 stars (62.4% bad) vs. 4.29 (9.3%) on time, and the score falls step by step with the delay: 4.32 when 15+ days early, 4.03 on the estimated day, 3.29 at 1-3 days late, ~1.7 at 8+ days late (association, not proven causation).
Insight 2: Olist over-estimates delivery time by ~12 days (12.5 actual vs. 24.4 estimated), yet 6.8% of orders still arrive late, by 10.6 days on average.
Insight 3: RJ is the second-largest market but has a 12.1% late rate vs. 4.5% in SP - the biggest operational opportunity.
